propositions: Cumulative error counters in observability.sh advance their offset file before CloudWatch accepts the put-metric-data call, causing transient AWS failures to permanently lose the interval's count.

Seven metric streams across six code shapes (replication, voter, merge-change, deploy, shared deferral/interrupt helper, and G2P) exhibit the same defect where failed publication followed by retry computes zero instead of the accumulated delta.
The fix reorders each publish block so the offset advances only after a successful CloudWatch call, preserving exit-zero behavior and allowing failed metrics to remain unacknowledged for retry.
Whole-script PATH-shim regression tests prove offset remains byte-identical after forced AWS failure and subsequently republishes the accumulated delta on successful retry.
